featured_reviews.name: snowa
featured_reviews.review_text:
.
It seems like many of the positive reviews are fake, possibly written by students under pressure. I initially thought it was just me, but my friend, who also joined regretted it, had the same negative experience.

The teaching pace is extremely slow, and the instructors is quite rude, as if they are offering the course for free—even though I paid the full fee upfront. They cover only a few topics, and honestly, YouTube provides better lessons.  Even though the long breaks and unnecessary holidays were their fault. Despite this, they refuse to revise topics when asked.

Their main focus seems to be taking students' money rather than providing quality education. They lure students in with promises of job placements, but once they receive the payment, they forget everything. A course they claim will take one month ends up stretching to five, and if you forget something, they blame you instead of acknowledging their poor teaching methods.
PLEASE GUYS AND GIRLS DON'T TAKE ADMISSION HERE. YOU CAN LEARN BETTER ON YOUTUBE. IT'S A WASTE OF MONEY .
